comparison.objective: Hand-thread and tighten a spin-on oil filter after gasket contact; candidate stops before any threading or tightening.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial thread engagement and controlled rotational tightening versus eccentric groove entry and snap seating.
comparison.success_condition: Filter gasket contact followed by the prescribed fractional turn without looseness or over-tightening versus unthreaded collet retention.
comparison.reason: Candidate explicitly excludes the defining threaded tightening ability. Candidate snap-force threshold is absent but immaterial to distinction.
